name: Everything is a Power Roll
description: 2d10 plus one characteristic decides every attack, test and resistance — no miss, only three tiers of how well it goes.

reader.text: When the outcome is uncertain — an attack, a test, a resistance — roll **2d10, add one characteristic**, read the tier. There is no miss and no wasted turn: tier 1 is the weakest result, never nothing.
An {@combat edge} is +2; a {@combat bane} −2. They never stack past two — doubles move the tier instead; one of each cancels. Natural 19–20 is a **critical**: tier 3 and you immediately act again.
No target numbers — the tier IS the outcome. Tier 1 fails forward at a cost, tier 2 succeeds with a wrinkle, tier 3 is clean. Skills grant an edge when they apply.

name: Might
description: Might drives melee **damage-dealing abilities**, {@combat forced-movement|forced movement} distances, breaking objects, and resisting being {@condition grabbed}. Knights and Furies lead with it.

name: Agility
description: Agility governs ranged finesse, dodging and tumbling clear of danger, keeping your balance on a ledge, moving unseen, and lining up a shot. Rangers and Tacticians lean on it.

name: The Lich's Lair
description: A mini-adventure played end-to-end — every roll shown, every speaker lit.

properties.intro: Each part teaches the rules it touches. Pick where to drop in:

lessons._sample: Every lesson below is sample teaching text written for this widget, not Draw Steel rules text.

p1.title: Montage test
p1.lede: A {@action montage-test|montage test} turns one big job — getting into a barrow unseen — into a run of tests. Each hero tackles it their own way, with whatever skill fits.
p1.after: The Director decides how many successes the party needs and how many failures it can afford. A failure isn't the end of the job — it's pressure, and whichever total fills first decides how the job goes.

p2.title: The minion squad
p2.lede: {@combat minion|Minions} are weak alone and dangerous together. A squad shares one Stamina pool: each time the pool drops by one minion's worth, one of them falls.

captain.name: Cult Adept
captain.note: while their {@combat captain|captain} still stands, the squad fights harder

p3.title: The lich's card
p3.lede: A {@combat solo|solo creature} stands in for a whole encounter by itself — a big Stamina pool, extra actions, and {@resource malice|Malice}-fuelled abilities.

spends.buys: a curse that weakens the whole party

p4.title: Victories and the respite
p4.lede: The party tallies {@resource victories|Victories} for the fight, then can call a {@resource respite|respite} to convert them into lasting rewards and recover.
p4.after: A respite isn't just a long rest — it's the moment Victories turn into Experience and every Recovery comes back.
